translations.web: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.
translations.bsb: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished male goat as his offering.
translations.kjv: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
translations.asv: if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, be made known to him, he shall bring for his oblation a goat, a male without blemish.
